evidence.what_it_decides: Vendor-primary checksum practice: CRC64NVME default alongside CRC32/CRC32C/SHA variants with client compute and server revalidation; fixes algorithm semantics, not whether storage_identity or integrity module owns the symbol.

rationale: Two digest-distinct compute_checksum definitions mirror legitimate role split (at-rest validation vs pipeline integrity); S3 documentation fixes algorithms but cannot allocate internal ownership. Non-collapse law dictates qualified local symbol identities per context.

rationale: OCI and WASI are peer authorities for disjoint backends, confirming the abstraction trait outranks either adapter. Single identical digest in runtime_resource_control family: elect one family owner per non-collapse law; other side imports.
